name: Anime Town Biloxi
blurb: A stop of the Anime Town multi-city tour at the Mississippi Coast Coliseum and Convention Center in Biloxi, with anime voice actors and cosplay.

last.venue: Mississippi Coast Coliseum and Convention Center

notes: Own page ('Anime Town Biloxi 2026 will be the biggest anime convention to ever come to Biloxi! Year two!... August 28, 3:00 PM-8:00 PM August 29... August 30...') shows the 'year two' 2026 edition already concluded well before this check (2026-10-05); the brand's main animetowncons.com homepage lists Biloxi's next date as 'TBD', so no 2027 edition has been announced yet. Part of the multi-city Anime Town tour — see the Greenville, Huntsville, Louisiana/Bossier City and Pensacola files for the other stops. Note: hero:1/hero:2 image alt text on this page's own extract misleadingly reads 'Anime Town Pensacola' (a copy/paste leftover on the organizer's site), so the cover uses the untitled hero:0 photo instead.
